name.description: Eval name (defaults to the file stem).

run.description: Shell command to execute (stdout+stderr merged is the match corpus). Runs with user privileges, no timeout, no sandbox.

pattern.description: match: substring or regex to look for.

regex.description: match: treat pattern as a regular expression.

present.description: match: false inverts (pattern must be absent).

file.description: match/json_field: corpus or document path, relative to --repo.

path.description: file_exists: path that must exist, relative to --repo.

field.description: json_field: dot path (numeric segments index arrays), e.g. stats.errors.

equals.description: json_field: expected JSON value (any type, compared strictly).

value.description: max_ms: run wall-time budget in milliseconds.
